executive_summary: Jayashan Manodya is an IT undergraduate specializing in Artificial Intelligence, currently pursuing a BSc (Hons) at the Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology. With a GPA of 3.93/4.0 in his most recent semester, he has demonstrated exceptional academic performance. His projects include a full-stack AI-powered shopping assistant, a RAG-powered document question-answering system, and an AI license plate detection system. He has also developed a weather prediction platform and a smart tea estate management system. Jayashan has gained practical experience as a Creative Designer at Glanz Digital and is actively involved in extracurricular activities, including the IEEE Computer Society. He has received multiple certifications in AI and web development and has been recognized on the Dean's List for achieving a GPA above 3.7. His references include academic instructors from SLIIT.

section_summaries.summary: Jayashan Manodya is an IT undergraduate with a focus on Artificial Intelligence, aspiring to become an AI Engineer. He is engaged in various AI domains including Generative AI, machine learning, and computer vision, and has developed several AI projects.
Currently pursuing a BSc (Hons) in IT specializing in AI at the Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology with a GPA of 3.93/4.0. Completed G.C.E Advanced Level with a Z-Score of +0.84.

Jayashan has developed multiple AI-powered applications including a conversational shopping assistant, a document question-answering system, a license plate recognition system, a weather prediction platform, and a smart tea estate management platform.
Part-time Creative Designer at Glanz Digital, focusing on digital marketing materials and collaborating with teams on client projects.
Active member of the IEEE Computer Society and held leadership roles at Prince College.
Proficient in multiple programming languages and frameworks, with expertise in AI and machine learning tools, databases, and deployment technologies.
Completed various certifications in AI, programming, web development, and digital marketing.
Recognized on the Dean's List for high GPA, ranked 11th in Bashaway 2024, and a finalist in IoT Project Showcase.
